text:
paul: Quick QA request 1  final Product Launch blog draft is up on preview. Need a fast pass on hero language, benchmark wording, and the CTA & webinar lead routing. Target publish Mon 9am PT.

nina: Link?

paul: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/1748800123  focus on hero + benchmark callout + UTMs in CTAs.

claire: Hero suggestion: 'Predictable inference for production apps'  short and less claim-y than superlatives.

vishal: For the benchmark line, avoid raw percentages. How about: 'In Dedicated tests, workloads sustained high token throughput while median latency typically stayed near 100ms on representative prompts.'

tara: Add a parenthetical test note for transparency: '(test config: 4xH100, seq_len=256, mixed-batch eval)'. Collapse on mobile.

paul: Good — I'll add that. Ops: please confirm UTMs and HubSpot hidden fields for both hero CTA and webinar form. Need server-side tagging for direct CTA clicks.

ops-bot: Suggested UTMs: hero CTA -> utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=prodx_launch_may2026; webinar CTA -> utm_source=blog&utm_medium=webinar&utm_campaign=prodx_launch_may2026. HubSpot hidden fields: campaign=prodx_launch_may2026, lead_source=blog, product_interest=dedicated. We'll implement server-side tag 'prodx_launch_may2026' for direct clicks and map webinar signups to tag 'webinar_prodx_may2026'.

claire: CTA copy: top hero 'See Product X in action' (webinar), bottom CTA 'Get started' (trial). Use separate UTMs per ops-bot.

vishal: Legal/product reminder: soften 'near 100ms' with 'typically' and avoid competitor comparisons or absolutes like 'always' or 'guarantee'.

legal: Quick flag: replace any 'guaranteed' language. Add privacy line by the webinar form: 'We process contact details according to our Privacy Policy.' I'm available for a 20-min pass after edits.

paul: Added privacy line and softened benchmark phrasing. Also added a placeholder customer quote block for layout: "Redwood helped us lower latency and simplify inference ops"  placeholder.

claire: Visuals: I'll need final copy to export hero PNG and benchmark SVG. ETA 60-90m after freeze. Put the test-config callout in a tooltip on desktop.

paul: Pushed edits to preview. Preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/1748800123. Tagging @legal for final quick pass.

legal: Received  will review in 20.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: apply server-side tag and hidden fields at publish and ensure HubSpot webhook notifies Sales Ops for webinar signups.

deploy-bot: preview deployed at https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/1748800123  expires in 48h :rocket:

paul: Thanks everyone. Plan: legal pass this afternoon, ops to wire tags, design to deliver assets, schedule publish Mon 9am PT. I'll post when legal clears. :tada:
